messages.subject: Parental Allele
parts:
Good day everyone, please how do I determine which of the 2 allele classes in from the male or female parent? My genomic data was derived from hapmap data originally. I have estimated QTL effects but I am not sure if they are in the right direction (positive or negative effects) using (mean AA - mean BB) / 2.
I will really appreciate your kind suggestions.

Thanks.
